entry.title: Migrating moth uses Earth’s magnetic field as a compass

media:group.media:title: Migrating moth uses Earth’s magnetic field as a compass
media:group.media:description: Every year, the Bogong moth sets off on long migrations through the night. To find its way, it uses the stars as a guide. Now, a new study from Lund University shows that, like migratory birds, the moth also has a built-in magnetic compass that helps it stay on course.

media:group.media:title: EUGLOH Ambassadorship Programme
media:group.media:description:
What happens when students from 10 European universities come together? New ideas, new friendships, and new perspectives.
Recently, student representatives met in Porto, Portugal as part of the EUGLOH Ambassadorship Programme to discuss student engagement and representation across the alliance.
EUGLOH is more than courses and workshops. It's an opportunity to connect with students across Europe, explore new cultures, and gain experiences that stay with you long after the mobility ends.
Ready for your own EUGLOH adventure?
Film: Yuka Alexandriyski, Timothy Parker.

media:group.media:title: Så påverkas skyddsvallen av stormvågor
media:group.media:description:
En naturbaserad vall ska skydda människor och bebyggelse mot kraftiga stormvågor, men hur påverkar jord och växter dess motståndskraft? Det undersöker forskare vid Lunds universitet just nu på Falsterbonäset med hjälp av en vågmaskin som simulerar stormvågor. Resultaten ska användas för att öka kunskapen om hur kustsamhällen kan skyddas när havsnivån stiger.
Forskningen görs inom EU-projektet LIFECAPEable, där Lunds universitet samarbetar med Delft University of Technology, Vellinge kommun och miljöföretaget Ecogain.

entry.title: Have you heard of Run & Crumb?

media:group.media:title: Have you heard of Run & Crumb?
media:group.media:description:
Have you heard of Run & Crumb?
Run & Crumb is a social run club in Lund where participants meet twice a week for an easy-paced run and then reward themselves with a sweet treat afterwards.
It’s the perfect opportunity to stay active, connect with new people, and become part of the vibrant student community in Lund.
And that's just one example of the many fantastic student organisations, clubs, and communities you can join here. From sports and culture to volunteering and special-interest groups, Lund offers countless ways to make friends, pursue your passions, and create unforgettable memories.
It's no surprise that Lund is often considered to have one of the best student lives in Northern Europe.
Video: @runandcrumb (Instagram)
